desc:
ORIGIN 起源 — Every journey begins at the origin.
Every journey begins at the origin.

Start as a mortal and cultivate your way past the heavens. Meditate to gather Qi, temper your body and break through 44 realms, from Mortal all the way to Apex Beyond Heaven.

Master martial arts and legendary weapons: the Heavenly Spear, the Ruyi Jingu Bang, Blossom Sword, Tang Clan Poison Arts, Demonic Arts and more
Choose your race, Qi type and bloodline
Found or join a sect, grow its treasury and climb the sect leaderboards
Take on world bosses and raids: the Nine-Tailed Fox, the Locked Up Demon of Heaven and Sun Wukong himself
Climb the Heavenly Ladder into Heaven, where a new event begins every 30 minutes
Reincarnate for Dao Remnants and grow stronger with every life
Duel other cultivators in PvP, or turn PvP off and cultivate in peace
Claim the one-of-a-kind title: War God of the Jianghu

NEW - THE HEAVENS UPDATE: Heaven opens, 10 new realms, new bosses, Heaven events, new pills and Spirit Serva
